name: Pure Strength (Heaven)
text: Pure energy of action, initiative and a strength that needs nothing in order to get moving.
advice: Act boldly and consistently, but with moderation: strength without direction burns itself out.
lines: The strength is still hidden. Do not act rashly; prepare.
The first results are visible; look for people you can learn from.
A great deal of work and tension. Stay alert, but do not wear yourself out.
You face a choice: to leap or to wait. Both are good if they are sincere.
The fullness of possibility. Act on a grand scale and seek the support of the wise.
Pride taken too far: whoever climbs too high begins to regret it.

name: Yielding Ground (Earth)
text: Openness, patience and a yielding quality that lets something grow.
advice: Do not lead now. Follow, support, let things ripen.
lines: The first frost announces winter. Notice small signs before they grow.
Be simple and sincere; being natural will bring success.
Work in the background without seeking recognition; the results will come.
Time to close your mouth and your purse. Caution protects against mistakes.
Modesty in an important role brings great good fortune.
A struggle of opposing forces: when both sides grow more stubborn, both lose.

name: Sprouting
text: The chaos of first steps: everything is sprouting, but nothing has settled yet.
advice: Do not be put off by the confusion. Ask for help and do not force the pace.
lines: An obstacle at the start. Stop, but do not abandon the goal.
Help is coming, though not at once. Do not accept it from the wrong hands.
Without a guide it is easy to lose your way. Better to let go than to go on blindly.
Accept the help you ask for; cooperation brings progress now.
You have resources but cannot use them fully yet. Small steps.
Discouragement and tears. This is not the end, only the bottom you push off from.

name: The Young Learner
text: You do not know everything yet, and that is the starting point for learning.
advice: Ask, learn from the experienced, do not pretend to be an expert.
lines: A little discipline helps learning, but do not shut yourself up in severity.
Patience with other people's ignorance is a sign of maturity.
Do not chase what merely glitters; hold on to what is essential.
Stubbornly staying ignorant leads to humiliation. Open yourself to learning.
Childlike openness brings success.
When someone has to be corrected, do it to protect, not to punish.

name: Patient Waiting
text: The matter is ripening; the rain will come, but not now.
advice: Wait calmly and with trust. Prepare instead of growing impatient.
lines: You are waiting far from danger. Keep calm and keep to your routine.
Petty gossip and unease. Do not react and it will pass.
You are waiting in the mud and drawing trouble to yourself; be careful.
In a difficult place: get out of it calmly, without panic.
Waiting at a well-laid table. Enjoy the moment and do not lose sight of the goal.
Unexpected guests. Receive them with respect and they will help.

name: Dispute
text: Tension, differing claims, a risk of conflict.
advice: Look for agreement halfway. Do not pursue the dispute to the end at any price.
lines: Do not prolong the dispute; a few words of explanation are enough.
Withdrawing from a fight you cannot win is wisdom, not shame.
Hold to what is yours by tradition and do not reach for more.
Give up the dispute and return to calm; you will gain more.
A dispute settled fairly brings good fortune.
A dispute won by force brings a reward that is easily lost.

name: The Troops
text: Organised strength, discipline and a shared goal.
advice: Order and good leadership are needed. Act as a team and with a plan.
lines: Order at the start decides everything; without it, defeat.
A leader in the middle of the team, close to the people: trust brings success.
Too many are giving orders at once, and that leads to failure.
Withdrawing in good time is not a mistake.
Act against the threat, but hand command to the experienced.
After victory, give tasks to the wise, not to those who merely shout.

name: Standing Together
text: Joining with others, community, belonging.
advice: Look for allies and inspire trust. Do not delay in joining.
lines: Sincerity from the start builds true unity.
Closeness that comes from within. Keep your own dignity.
Be careful whom you bind yourself to; not everyone is right for you.
Open loyalty to someone worthy brings good.
A true leader attracts and does not compel.
Joining too late may prove impossible. Do not delay.

name: Small Restraint
text: Small obstacles slow things down but do not stop them.
advice: Act gently and in small steps. This is not yet the time for grand gestures.
lines: Return to your own path; that is no mistake.
Others return along with you; returning together brings good fortune.
The cart loses a wheel: a quarrel blocks progress. Agreement first.
Sincerity removes fear and harm.
Loyalty binds people together and shares out wealth.
The rain has come. Time to rest and not to push further.

name: Careful Steps
text: Careful steps in a delicate situation, like treading on a tiger's tail.
advice: Keep your tact and courtesy. Good manners protect you from trouble.
lines: A simple, modest path. Follow it and no harm will come.
A calm, level path, good for those who do not seek attention.
You overestimate your strength and may get hurt.
Caution in a dangerous place brings success in the end.
Resolve is needed, but so is awareness of the risk.
Look back at your steps: what is coming follows from them.

name: Harmony
text: The harmony of heaven and earth: a favourable time.
advice: Make use of the good period, build and share. Remember that good fortune changes too.
lines: Good things come together; act with others.
Be understanding towards the weaker and do not forget those who are far away.
There is no plain without a slope. Remember that in good times.
Come down to others without superiority; sincerity unites.
A good union brings blessing.
The wall falls back into the moat. Do not use force now; put your own affairs in order.

name: Blockage
text: Things are not flowing, and understanding is hard to reach.
advice: Do not push. Keep your values and wait it out without being drawn into bad arrangements.
lines: Withdraw together with those who are like you, and keep your values.
Bear patiently what is hard, and do not enter into bad arrangements.
Shame hidden inside. Admit it to yourself.
Act in line with what is higher, and the standstill will begin to give way.
The standstill is ending, but take care: everything is still fragile.
The standstill turns round: first difficulty, then joy.

name: Kindred People
text: People come together around a shared goal.
advice: Act openly and look for what is shared, not for what divides.
lines: Fellowship at the gate: openness to everyone without exception.
Fellowship only within your own circle leads to humiliation.
Hidden weapons and mistrust: nothing good will come of it for years.
You climb the wall but do not attack. Stopping in good time is good fortune.
First tears, then laughter: a true bond overcomes obstacles.
Fellowship on the outskirts: you regret nothing, though the goal is not yet reached.

name: Having Much
text: Abundance, success, a great deal in your hands.
advice: Be generous and modest: prosperity lasts when it serves others too.
lines: You possess a great deal, but without pride; you avoid error.
A great wagon for loading: you have the resources to do something important.
Share what you have; selfishness will destroy prosperity.
Do not boast; modesty protects wealth.
Sincerity joined with dignity brings respect.
Support from above: everything is favourable.

name: Humility
text: A strength that has no need to show itself.
advice: Do not set yourself above others. Modesty evens out what is unequal and opens doors.
lines: Modest twice over, you will cross the great water.
Modesty that shows outwardly brings good fortune.
Hard-working modesty brings things to completion.
Modesty in action: everything goes well.
Modesty does not mean passivity; sometimes you must act firmly.
Modesty towards yourself: put your own affairs in order first.

name: Delight
text: A joyful energy that carries others along.
advice: Spread your zeal, but prepare the ground: enthusiasm needs a plan.
lines: Boasting of your enthusiasm brings misfortune.
Firm as a rock: recognise the moment and do not get carried away.
Looking upwards in hope without acting leads to regret.
The source of enthusiasm: you attract people through sincerity.
A long illness without death: lasting pressure that does not break you.
Blind enthusiasm. If you change, you will avoid error.

name: Going Along
text: Adapting to the course of things and to someone who leads.
advice: Follow what is right, not what is convenient.
lines: The situation changes. Leave the house and seek contact with others.
You hold on to the small and lose the great. Choose wisely.
You hold on to the great and lose the small, and that is good.
Following with a hidden aim. Be honest with yourself.
Sincerity towards what is good brings good fortune.
A deep bond that is hard to break. Stay with it.

name: Mending Decay
text: Something neglected needs putting in order.
advice: Deal with the source of the problem, not the symptoms. Repair calls for thought before and after.
lines: You are repairing what the father spoiled: hard, but good.
You are repairing what the mother spoiled: do it gently.
You are repairing too forcefully: a little regret, but no great error.
Tolerating what is spoiled leads to humiliation.
The repair brings recognition.
You do not serve kings; you look after your own values.

name: Drawing Near
text: Something good is coming; a time of growth.
advice: Use this period, but remember that every season passes.
lines: Approaching together: perseverance brings good fortune.
Approaching together: everything is favourable.
An approach that is too easy and comfortable. Notice it and change.
A complete approach: no error.
A wise approach, worthy of a leader.
A generous approach: good fortune.

name: Watching
text: The view from above, observation, understanding.
advice: Stop and look. Your example says more than words.
lines: You look as a child does: fine for the simple, not enough for the wise.
You look through a crack: too narrow a view.
Look at your own life and decide whether to go forward or to step back.
You observe the splendour of others: time to become a guest at an important table.
Look at yourself. If you are upright, there is no error.
Look at your life from a distance.

name: Jaws Closing
text: An obstacle that has to be broken through decisively.
advice: Name the problem and solve it firmly but fairly.
lines: A small penalty at the start prevents a greater evil.
You bite too deep, but that is no error.
Tough food and poison: a little shame, no great harm.
A hard bone: perseverance in difficulty brings benefit.
Gold in the dried meat: be just and firm.
A lesson learned too late: you do not listen, so you pay.

name: Adornment
text: Beauty, form, elegance.
advice: Take care of the form, but do not mistake it for the content. Important matters need more than ornament.
lines: Adorn your steps: choose the modest path on foot, not the carriage.
Adorning the beard: form without content means nothing.
Beauty and moisture: hold to your values and it will be well.
Simplicity or splendour? White is more beautiful than ornaments.
A modest gift from a sincere heart has value.
Plain white: no ornaments, no error.

name: Peeling Away
text: Old structures are crumbling.
advice: Do not undertake anything big now. Wait it out and look after the foundations.
lines: The leg of the bed crumbles: the collapse begins at the base.
The collapse reaches the frame of the bed. Stay alert.
Walk away from what is crumbling: no blame.
The collapse touches you. Stop and protect what you can.
Favour for those who stayed faithful: improvement is coming.
A great fruit left uneaten: after the collapse comes renewal.

name: Coming Back
text: The turning point: light returns after the darkness.
advice: Let the new grow slowly. Return to what is right for you.
lines: A return from not far away: no regret, great good fortune.
A quiet return: good.
Repeated returns: dangerous, but no error.
You walk with others but return alone: that is your path.
A noble return: no regret.
A missed return: disaster. Come back while you can.

name: Without Pretence
text: Acting without hidden motives; simplicity.
advice: Be sincere and spontaneous. Scheming will do harm now.
lines: Innocent action brings good fortune.
Do not count on the harvest before you sow; do what needs doing.
Undeserved misfortune: it will pass.
Stay with innocence: no error.
An illness that is not your fault: do not force a cure; it will pass by itself.
Acting without order now brings harm. Wait it out.

name: Great Restraint
text: Stored-up energy, knowledge and resources.
advice: Use what you have learned. A good time for great undertakings.
lines: Danger. Stop.
A wagon without an axle. Do not set off now.
A good horse runs: train, and be ready for the road.
A board is put on the horns of a young bull: prevent before it is too late.
A gelded boar: direct the force indirectly, not head-on.
The road to heaven is open: great success.

name: Feeding
text: Care about what you feed yourself with: body, mind, words.
advice: Pay attention to what you take in and what you give to others.
lines: You leave your own wisdom behind and look enviously at others: a mistake.
You seek nourishment from the wrong people: not worth it.
Feeding on what harms you: change your habits.
You seek support from those wiser than you: good.
You are not yet ready for great tasks; stay with your own people.
A source of nourishment for others: great responsibility and good fortune.

name: Great Excess
text: The weight exceeds your strength; the beam is sagging.
advice: Act quickly but carefully: reduce the load before something breaks.
lines: Caution at the start: lay a white mat underneath.
An old tree puts out shoots: new life is possible.
The beam bends to breaking point. Do not push.
The beam is propped up: good, but do not take advantage of it.
An old tree blossoms: a brief effect, without depth.
You wade through water over your head: a risk, but no blame.

name: The Deep (Water)
text: Danger; a difficulty that keeps returning.
advice: Flow like water: steadily and without panic. Keep your inner sincerity.
lines: An abyss within the abyss: you are falling deeper. Stop.
Danger. Be content with small steps.
The abyss is all around. Do not act; wait.
Simple sincerity is enough, even a modest gift.
The abyss does not overflow: things will level out.
Entangled in difficulties for a long time. Look patiently for the way out.

name: Radiance (Fire)
text: Brightness, clarity, dependence on what sustains you.
advice: Shine, but remember where you draw your strength from. Look after your sources.
lines: Steps in disorder. Stay serious and attentive.
Golden light: great good fortune.
The light of the setting sun: make your peace with transience.
A sudden light soon goes out. Do not get carried away.
Tears and sighs: sincere regret brings a change.
The king sets out: remove the cause and spare the rest.

name: Mutual Attraction
text: Mutual attraction, courtship, influence.
advice: Be open and receptive. True influence needs no pressure.
lines: Influence in the toes: only an intention so far, with no effect yet.
Influence in the calves: do not move rashly.
Influence in the thighs: following others without thinking.
Perseverance and a sincere intention: the influence works.
Influence in the nape of the neck: no regret, but no depth either.
Influence in the jaw: words alone are not enough.

name: Constancy
text: Constancy, faithfulness, endurance.
advice: Hold to the direction you have chosen: duration does not mean standing still.
lines: You want permanence too quickly: nothing will come of it.
Regret disappears; you keep to moderation.
An inconstant character brings shame.
A hunt with no game: you are looking in the wrong place.
Constancy that is good in one thing and bad in another. Be flexible.
Constant agitation: nothing lasting will come of it.

name: Withdrawal
text: A wise withdrawal when opposing forces are growing.
advice: Withdraw in good time and with dignity. It is not flight but strategy.
lines: At the tail end of the retreat there is danger. Do not act.
Hold on tight: loyalty brings safety.
A retreat bound up with others: hard, but necessary.
A voluntary retreat, beneficial for the wise.
A friendly retreat: good.
A cheerful retreat: everything is favourable.

name: Great Vigour
text: Power at its full, but easily abused.
advice: Use your strength with care and in line with what is right.
lines: Strength in the legs: a hasty move brings trouble.
Perseverance brings good fortune.
The ram butts the fence and tangles its horns. Do not use force.
The fence opens: the way is clear.
The ram is lost without difficulty: no regret.
The ram is stuck in the fence. Admit the difficulty, and then you will find the way out.

name: Advance
text: Rapid growth, recognition, the rising sun.
advice: Go forward, but share the light with others.
lines: Progress is blocked. Stay calm and trusting.
Progress amid sadness: support will come from someone close.
Everyone agrees: regret disappears.
Progress like a hamster: greed is dangerous.
Do not worry about gain and loss; act.
Progress with horns: use them only on yourself.

name: Hidden Brightness
text: A hard time, when it is better not to show everything.
advice: Protect your light within. Be careful, but do not abandon your principles.
lines: The light dims in flight. Leave, even if hungry.
Wounded but not defeated: seek help quickly.
Hunting in the south: you will catch the leader, but do not hurry.
You penetrate the heart of the darkness: you will understand, and leave.
Hide your light, as the wise Jizi did, and you will endure.
The darkness rises to its peak and falls by itself.

name: The Household
text: Home, roles, mutual care.
advice: Put close relationships in order: everything else starts there.
lines: Clear rules in the family from the beginning.
Care for the home and the meals: perseverance brings good fortune.
Too strict or too lax? Better a little strictness.
The family's prosperity: great good fortune.
A king in his own house: do not be afraid; it will be well.
Sincerity and dignity: good fortune in the end.

name: Divergence
text: Differences, diverging directions.
advice: Agreement is possible in small matters. Do not expect agreement on everything.
lines: A lost horse will come back by itself. Do not chase it.
You meet your lord in a narrow lane: no error.
The wagon held back, the ox halted: a hard start, a good ending.
Alone in opposition: you will meet a kindred spirit.
Regret disappears: a friend bites through the skin.
You see enemies where there are none. Lower your bow: they are allies.

name: Hard Going
text: The way is blocked.
advice: Stop, take stock of yourself and ask for help. Sometimes it is better to go round than to break through.
lines: Going forward: obstacles. Coming back: recognition.
Obstacle after obstacle, but not through your own fault.
Going forward: obstacles. Return to your own people.
Going forward: obstacles. Coming back: union.
Great obstacles: friends arrive.
Going forward: obstacles. Coming back: great good fortune.

name: Release
text: Relief after tension; the storm passes.
advice: Forgive, let go and return to ordinary life. Do not drag out the fight.
lines: No error. Rest after a hard time.
Three foxes caught, a golden arrow: honesty wins.
You carry a load and ride in a carriage, attracting thieves. Do not show off.
Free yourself from bad company, and better will come.
Deliverance through an inner change.
A hawk shot down from the wall: the obstacle is removed.

name: Lessening
text: Something has to be given up or reduced.
advice: Simplify and give up the excess: less can give more.
lines: Finish your own work and help others quickly, but in moderation.
Help without losing yourself.
Three walk together and one leaves; one walks alone and finds a companion.
Lessen your faults and joy will come quickly.
Someone enriches you unexpectedly. Accept it.
Increase without loss: good.

name: Gain
text: Growth, support, a favourable wind.
advice: Use the opportunity to grow and to help others.
lines: A time for a great work: great good fortune.
Someone enriches you: perseverance brings good fortune.
Enrichment through difficulties: sincerity protects.
Acting as a go-between in a good cause: worthwhile.
A sincere heart: do not ask; good fortune is certain.
No one enriches you, and someone may harm you. Change your attitude.

name: Resolve
text: Resolve, decision, a way out of deadlock.
advice: Speak the truth clearly but without aggression. Be ready for the consequences.
lines: Too strong a start: failure.
Vigilance in the night: do not be afraid.
Resolve in anger: keep yourself composed.
No skin on the thighs: you walk with difficulty. Listen to advice.
Weeds call for resolve: act in the middle of the road.
No warning: the end comes suddenly.

name: Encounter
text: An unexpected encounter, a temptation.
advice: Be careful what you let into your life. Not everything that attracts you is good.
lines: Stop it at once: a bronze brake.
A fish in the bag: you are in control. Do not share it with the guests.
No skin on the thighs: difficulties, but no great error.
No fish in the bag: you are losing touch with people.
A melon under the willow: hidden beauty is ripening.
Meeting with horns: humiliation, but no blame.

name: Gathering
text: People gather; a shared goal.
advice: Bring others together around values, and be prepared for the unforeseen.
lines: Uncertain sincerity: the gathering is on, then off. Call for help.
Let yourself be drawn in: good fortune.
Gathering with a sigh: a little shame. Go on.
Great good fortune: no error.
Gathering with authority: strengthen trust.
Tears and sighs: no error.

name: Rising
text: Gradual growth, like a tree from the earth.
advice: Go step by step. Effort now will bring a lasting result.
lines: Rising with trust: great good fortune.
Sincerity is enough, even a modest offering.
You rise into an empty city: no obstacles.
The king makes an offering on the mountain: good fortune.
Perseverance: you rise step by step.
Rising in the dark: perseverance is essential.

name: Hemmed In
text: Exhaustion, constraint.
advice: Do not lose faith. Say less and act wisely: this time will make you stronger.
lines: You sit under a bare tree, downcast. Leave the valley.
Oppression amid food and drink. Wait; help will come.
Oppressed by a stone: you lean on what wounds you.
Help comes slowly: shame, but a good ending.
Oppressed by those in power: joy comes slowly.
Oppressed by creepers: act, and regret will pass.

name: The Well
text: An inexhaustible source, a common good.
advice: Look after your sources and share them. Go deeper instead of moving elsewhere.
lines: A muddy well: no one drinks from it.
A well with small fish, and a cracked jug: potential wasted.
A clear well left unused: a pity.
The well is being repaired: no error.
Clear, cold water: drink.
A well open to all: great good fortune.

name: Radical Change
text: Change, upheaval, shedding the old skin.
advice: Change when the time has come, and when you can explain why.
lines: Wrapped in yellow oxhide: do not change now.
The day of change has come: act.
Change that is too fast does harm. Talk it over three times.
Regret disappears: change from conviction.
The great person changes like a tiger: clearly.
The noble person changes like a panther, but do not overdo it.

name: The Vessel
text: Transformation, nourishment, culture.
advice: Cultivate what is valuable. Good results need time and fire.
lines: The cauldron turned upside down: clear out the old to make room.
The cauldron is full: the envious cannot reach it.
The cauldron's handle is altered: a passing difficulty.
The cauldron's leg is broken: overload.
Yellow handles, golden rings: favourable.
Jade rings: great good fortune.

name: Shock (Thunder)
text: A sudden event, a shock.
advice: Stay calm. The shock passes, and what it taught you remains.
lines: Thunder comes: fear, then laughter.
Thunder amid danger: you will lose something, but get it back.
Thunder unsettles you. Act, to avoid misfortune.
Thunder in the mud: paralysis.
Thunder here and there: danger, but you lose nothing.
Thunder brings chaos. Do not move now.

name: Stillness (Mountain)
text: Calm, stillness, meditation.
advice: Stop. Act when it is time to act, and stand still when it is time to stand still.
lines: Keep your feet still: do not start what you will not finish.
Keep your calves still: you cannot help those you follow.
Keep your hips still: rigidity is dangerous.
Keep your trunk still: inner calm.
Keep your jaw still: speak with care.
Noble stillness: good fortune.

name: Step by Step
text: Slow, sure progress.
advice: Do not hurry: good things grow slowly.
lines: The wild goose approaches the shore: youth in danger.
The goose on a rock: eat and drink in peace.
The goose on the plateau: a man goes out and does not return.
The goose in a tree: it will find a branch.
The goose on the hill: three years without a child, but victory.
The goose approaches the clouds: its feathers are used in ceremonies.

name: The Young Bride
text: A situation in which you are not fully in control.
advice: Adapt with dignity, and remember the long-term goal.
lines: The second wife: a lame leg still moves forward.
The one-eyed can see: keep your solitude.
A servant: wait your turn.
A delayed marriage: the time will come.
The modest bride: more beautiful than ornaments.
An empty basket: it brings nothing.

name: Fullness
text: Fullness, the peak, like the sun at noon.
advice: Enjoy the fullness without fearing it will pass, and prepare wisely for change.
lines: You meet your equal: no error for ten days.
Fullness hides the sun: mistrust. Sincerity helps.
Fullness conceals: a lost hand, no blame.
You meet a ruler: good fortune.
Bright talents arrive: good fortune.
A house full to the brim: loneliness behind the walls.

name: The Traveller
text: Travel, strangeness, impermanence.
advice: Be courteous and careful in a new place. Do not put down roots too quickly.
lines: The wanderer busy with trifles brings trouble upon themselves.
The wanderer at the inn finds a servant.
The wanderer burns the inn and loses the servant.
The wanderer has shelter, but a restless heart.
The arrow hits the mark: praise and a position.
The bird burns its own nest: laughter, then weeping.

name: Soft Persistence (Wind)
text: Gentle but constant penetration.
advice: Act gently and persistently: dripping water wears away stone.
lines: Forward and back: discipline helps.
Gentleness under the bed: look for the causes.
Repeated gentleness: shame.
Regret disappears: three kinds of game.
Perseverance: good fortune after the change.
Gentleness under the bed: loss.

name: Gladness (Lake)
text: Cheerfulness, conversation, pleasure.
advice: Share your joy with others, but do not mistake it for indulgence.
lines: Harmonious joy: good fortune.
Sincere joy: good fortune.
Forced joy: misfortune.
Joy that is bargained over: constant uncertainty.
Trusting what destroys: danger.
Seductive joy: take care.

name: Scattering
text: Dissolving rigidity and divisions.
advice: Let go of what divides. A shared goal will bring people together again.
lines: Help with the strength of a horse: good fortune.
Dispersion: you run to what supports you.
Dispersing the self: no regret.
Dispersing the group: great good fortune.
Dispersing a great cry: no error.
Dispersing blood: no blame.

name: Measure
text: Boundaries, moderation, rules.
advice: Set sensible limits, but not so tight that they suffocate.
lines: You do not leave the courtyard: no error.
You do not go out of the gate: misfortune.
No limits: regret.
Calm limitation: success.
Pleasant limitation: good fortune.
Bitter limitation: perseverance is dangerous.

name: Sincerity Within
text: A sincerity that convinces.
advice: Be honest with yourself and with others. The truth reaches even the stubborn.
lines: Calm readiness: good fortune.
A crane calls in the shade and its young answer.
You find a companion: now the drum, now weeping.
The moon is nearly full: the horse goes away.
Sincerity unites: no error.
A cockerel's feather flies up to heaven: perseverance is dangerous.

name: Small Excess
text: A time for small matters, not great ones.
advice: Attend to the details and be modest. Do not aim too high now.
lines: The bird flies: misfortune.
You pass the ancestor and meet the ancestor's mother: no error.
Do not be overcautious; someone may hurt you.
No error. Do not go forward.
Dense clouds and no rain: take what is in the cave.
You do not meet; you pass by. The bird flies away.

name: Already Across
text: Something has been achieved; everything is in its place.
advice: Do not rest on your laurels. Look after what has been achieved, because order is easily lost at the end.
lines: You brake the wheels: no error.
The woman loses her veil. Do not search; it will return after seven days.
The great ancestor attacks, and wins after three years.
Cracks in the boat: keep watch all day.
The neighbour in the east slaughters an ox; a smaller offering from a sincere heart matters more.
You get your head wet: danger.

name: Not Yet Across
text: A transition; not the end yet.
advice: The last step needs the most attention. Do not celebrate too early.
lines: You get your tail wet: shame.
You brake the wheels: perseverance brings good fortune.
Before completion, action brings misfortune, but cross the water.
Perseverance: good fortune; regret disappears.
The light of the wise: good fortune.
You drink wine with trust: no error, but do not overdo it.
